description: Returns every profile you are currently monitoring, with its handle, platform, follower count, refresh cadence, next scheduled crawl time (nextCrawlDueAt), when its posts were last crawled (lastRefreshedAt), your get_tracked_updates cursor (lastCheckedAt: it moves when you call get_tracked_updates, not when a refresh runs), and any paused reason (e.g. paused for insufficient credits). Free to call. Use it to audit what is being refreshed and what it is costing, or to grab a profileId for untrack_profile. Cost: free.
name: list_tracked_profiles
title: List Monitored Profiles
